news.title: At what point does belief stop being speculation and become a fundamental?
news.summary:
Is belief a speculation or a fundamental?

We usually treat belief as something separate from fundamentals. But if you strip markets down to their core, every financial asset ultimately depends on collective belief. Someone has to believe that a stock, bond, currency, commodity, or token will be valued by someone else tomorrow. We simply give different kinds of belief different names.
